data.title: Preview: Jordan vs Australia - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
World Cup hero Mousa Al-Tamari is expected to lead the attack alongside Olwan and veteran forward Mahmoud Al-Mardi.

Australia, meanwhile, are missing several key players, with Cameron Burgess ruled out by a cruciate ligament injury and Jordan Bos also sidelined with a knee problem.

The Socceroos are also without skipper Mathew Ryan and fellow veterans Jackson Irvine and Milos Degenek, plus midfielder Aiden O'Neill, but it unclear whether they made themselves unavailable for safety reasons. [...] Diesel Herrington, Thomas Waddingham and Sam Klein are new call-ups, while striker Kusini Yengi joins brother Tete Yengi, while goalkeepers Joe Gauci and Tom Glover have been recalled.

Jordan possible starting lineup:

Al-Fakhouri; Badawi, Nasib, Rousan, Taha; Sadeh, Al-Rawabdeh, Qashi; Tamari, Olwan, Al-Mardi

Australia possible starting lineup:

Beach; Kasey Bos, Herrington, Souttar, Circati, Italiano; McGree, Metcalfe, Okon-Engstler; Irankunda, Yengi [...] © Imago / Xinhua

Jordan and Australia will face off in a rare November international friendly at Suheim Bin Hamad Stadium in Doha on Tuesday.

The home side are striving for consistency following their group-stage exit from the 2026 World Cup, while Australia will be looking to make it back-to-back away victories.

## Match preview

Jordan may have fallen short of the group-stage hurdle at their first-ever World Cup, but they still produced some memorable moments for their supporters.

data.title: Jordan vs Australia Prediction and Betting Tips | November 17th 2026
data.content:
Australia boast a superior record in the history of this fixture, having picked up five wins from the last eight meetings between the two nations.
 Jordan have managed three wins since their first encounter in September 2012, but they have lost each of their last three games against Australia, conceding four goals and scoring just once since November 2019. [...] Jordan are on a run of 10 consecutive friendly games without a win, losing five and claiming five draws since beating Dominican Republic 3-0 in September 2025.
 Australia have managed just one win from their most recent eight friendly matches, while losing five and claiming two draws since October 2025. [...] Ad

## Jordan vs Australia Prediction

Australia finally gave their fans something to cheer for at the weekend when they neatly dispatched Qatar at the Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium, and Popovic’s men will head into Tuesday’s tie with renewed confidence.

The Socceroos are up against a Jordan side yet to taste victory this year, and we are backing them to continue from where they left off against Qatar.

Ad

Prediction: Jordan 0-3 Australia

### The CommBank Socceroos face Jordan in a friendly match in Doha, Qatar, on Wednesday, 18 November AEDT and here is everything you need to know.

Tony Popovic’s side began the November FIFA International Window with a comfortable 3-0 win over Qatar and will now face Jordan for their final match of 2026.

This will be the first encounter against Jordan since a June 2022 friendly where Australia prevailed in a 2-1 victory. [...] Overall, the two nations have met on eight previous occasions with the Aussies recording five wins and three losses.

The match against Jordan will be streamed live on Australia's home of football, Paramount+.
